# FactoryPlug — Verified Factory Directory

> FactoryPlug (thefactoryplug.com) is a free directory of 3,731 vetted Alibaba supplier listings with real prices, real specs and real MOQs, plus 30 manufacturer profiles. No markup, no membership — free forever. Every listing links direct to the factory, so buyers skip the middleman and source car parts at factory-direct prices.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://thefactoryplug.com/): search 3,731 factory-direct listings by part, vehicle or category.
- [Wheels](https://thefactoryplug.com/wheels/): forged and flow-formed wheels direct from manufacturers.
- [Brakes](https://thefactoryplug.com/brakes/): big brake kits, rotors and pads, factory-direct.
- [Exhaust](https://thefactoryplug.com/exhaust/): exhaust systems, downpipes and mufflers from the factories.
- [Carbon fiber](https://thefactoryplug.com/carbon/): carbon fiber body parts, direct from the source.
- [Suspension](https://thefactoryplug.com/suspension/): coilovers and suspension components at factory prices.
- [Guides](https://thefactoryplug.com/guides/): who makes what — manufacturer and sourcing guides.

## How it works

FactoryPlug does not sell parts and charges nothing. Search or browse the directory, compare real factory prices, specs and MOQs side by side, then follow the direct supplier link on the listing to order from the manufacturer.
